# Laurel Way Partners

> Laurel Way Partners is an attorney-led platform that partners with elder law, estate planning and probate firms on Long Island, in Westchester and in New York City.

Laurel Way Partners works with owner-operators of elder law, estate planning, and probate and trust administration firms on Long Island, in Westchester and in the five boroughs, typically with roughly $750K–$3M in revenue and one to five attorneys. Owners choose one of two paths: partner and keep practicing (sell a minority stake to a New York–licensed attorney for liquidity, keep running the practice, have a services team handle marketing, intake, administration and technology under the firm's direction, and hold equity in the platform), or retire on their own timeline (a purchase by a New York–licensed attorney, structured under the professional rules on the sale of a law practice, staff kept, a structured handoff). Firms stay owned by attorneys; Laurel Way Partners holds no stake in any law firm. Conversations are confidential, and an NDA is signed before any detailed information about a practice is shared. Laurel Way Partners LLC is not a law firm and does not provide legal services. The firms we work with are independently owned and operated by licensed attorneys. Contact: hello@laurelwaypartners.com
